title: Stationary objects over Montana written off as Soviet surveillance

tellings.quote: The rumors were they're probably Soviet surveillance planes. Surveillance planes, you know, and the controller told me they were basically stationary. You know, are the Soviets flying helicopters over Montana? I don't think so.

plain: Objects were seen hanging almost still in the sky over Montana, and at the time people guessed they were Soviet spy planes. The UFO researcher Robert Hastings tells it. He says a controller told him the objects were "basically stationary," and he scoffs at the explanation: "are the Soviets flying helicopters over Montana? I don't think so." He tells it to suggest the objects were something other than ordinary aircraft.
